flags: Current 150-mile phrasing conflated corridor extent with total byway mileage. Tourism sources distinguish a 291-mile network and Havana 150 miles south of Ottawa.
Cache does not document creation or designation history of the entire byway network; overview history concerns Grandview Drive specifically. No corridor-wide builder or campaign is inferred.
Current Roosevelt praise is not an exact quotation: Grandview Drive page calls it a paraphrase, while tourism pages print it as a quote. Omitted it rather than perpetuating the conflict.
Starved Rock siege remains a legend, not a verified event. No tribal-authored cache source is available. Omitted the circa-1769 precision and retained the evidence limitation.

Tourism counts 14 waterfalls; Wikipedia refers to 18 waterfalls and variable persistence. Omitted a fixed waterfall count. Tourism’s glacier-carved shorthand is replaced by the park page’s meltwater-flood account.
Rockwell Mound page documents park operation only as of 2007; no current access promise is made. Mound dimensions retain the source’s qualifications.
Material contains two strip-mileage sequences for the two-bank network. Moments follow the tourism source’s north-to-south sequence rather than treating all mile values as one continuous route.
